title_en: Implementing Rules of the Supreme People's Court on Carrying Out the Implementation Outline and Several Opinions and on Constructing a Working Mechanism for Punishing and Preventing Corruption
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Circular on Issuing the "Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the 'Implementation Outline' and the 'Several Opinions' by People's Courts to Establish a Mechanism for Combating and Preventing Corruption"

Fa Fa [2008] No. 5

To all local people's courts at various levels, military courts at various levels, intermediate and basic people's courts of railway transport, maritime courts, and courts at various levels of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

In order to earnestly implement the spirit of the 17th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, implement the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China's "Implementation Outline for Establishing a Comprehensive System of Education, Institutions, and Supervision for Combating and Preventing Corruption" and the Supreme People's Court's "Several Opinions on Implementing the 'Implementation Outline for Establishing a Comprehensive System of Education, Institutions, and Supervision for Combating and Preventing Corruption'", and further strengthen the People's Courts' work on anti-corruption and integrity promotion, the "Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the 'Implementation Outline' and the 'Several Opinions' by People's Courts to Establish a Mechanism for Combating and Preventing Corruption" are hereby issued to you for earnest implementation in light of actual circumstances.

This document is also sent to the Party committees, People's Congresses, Discipline Inspection Commissions, and Political and Legal Affairs Committees of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, as well as the Party Committee, Discipline Inspection Commission, and Political and Legal Affairs Committee of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps. Please ask the higher people's courts and the branch of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps to deliver it on their behalf.

January 9, 2008

Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the "Implementation Outline" and the "Several Opinions" by People's Courts to Establish a Mechanism for Combating and Preventing Corruption

Vigorously advancing the establishment of a system for combating and preventing corruption is an important political task set forth by the 17th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. General Secretary Hu Jintao pointed out in his report to the 17th National Congress: "The nature and purpose of the Communist Party of China determine that the Party is fundamentally incompatible with all kinds of negative and corrupt phenomena. Resolutely punishing and effectively preventing corruption concerns the support of the people and the survival of the Party, and is a major political task that the Party must always grasp. All Party comrades must fully understand the protracted, complex, and arduous nature of the anti-corruption struggle, place the work of promoting integrity and combating corruption in a more prominent position, and oppose corruption in a clear-cut manner. Adhere to the policy of addressing both symptoms and root causes, comprehensive management, combining punishment and prevention, and focusing on prevention; vigorously advance the establishment of a system for combating and preventing corruption; while resolutely punishing corruption, pay more attention to addressing root causes, pay more attention to prevention, pay more attention to institutional construction, and expand the field of work for preventing corruption from the source." In order to earnestly implement the spirit of the 17th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, further implement the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China's "Implementation Outline for Establishing a Comprehensive System of Education, Institutions, and Supervision for Combating and Preventing Corruption" (hereinafter referred to as the "Implementation Outline") and the "Several Opinions on Implementing the 'Implementation Outline for Establishing a Comprehensive System of Education, Institutions, and Supervision for Combating and Preventing Corruption'" (hereinafter referred to as the "Several Opinions") issued by our court, strive to establish in the People's Courts a self-disciplinary mechanism for "not wanting to do wrong", a preventive mechanism for "not being able to do wrong", a punitive mechanism for "not daring to do wrong", and a guarantee mechanism for "not needing to do wrong", and continuously deepen the Party's work style, integrity promotion, and anti-corruption work in the People's Courts, these Detailed Rules are hereby formulated.

I. Strengthen Anti-Corruption and Integrity Education, Focus on Establishing a Self-Disciplinary Mechanism for "Not Wanting to Do Wrong"

1. Education is the foundation for the prevention and control of corruption. It is necessary to firmly grasp the basic link of education, continuously enrich the content of education, innovate the forms of education, and enhance the appeal and persuasiveness of education. We must focus on leading cadres such as court presidents and division chiefs, take the establishment of a Marxist worldview, outlook on life, values, and a correct outlook on power, status, and interests as the foundation, take hard work, integrity, and dedication to public service as the theme, so that judges and other staff firmly establish the ideals and beliefs of socialism with Chinese characteristics, earnestly implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, establish a socialist concept of honor and disgrace, abide by professional ethics, maintain personal integrity, remain unmoved by temptations, consciously withstand the severe test of corruption and anti-corruption under the conditions of a market economy, and build a solid ideological and moral defense line against corruption and degeneration.

2. Strengthen education on clean governance for leading cadres such as court presidents and division chiefs. People's courts at all levels should highlight anti-corruption and integrity education for leading cadres at all levels in the court, and adhere to the learning system of the Party leadership theory center group. The study of the spirit of the 17th National Congress and the study of anti-corruption theory should be regarded as important content in the theoretical study of leading cadres at all levels in the court. In light of actual circumstances, study plans should be formulated to organize leading cadres at all levels in the court to seriously study the theoretical system of socialism with Chinese characteristics, study the important thoughts of the Party's three central leadership collectives on anti-corruption and integrity, study Comrade Hu Jintao's important expositions on the Party's work style, integrity, and the fight against corruption, study the "Standards for Honest Conduct of Leading Cadres of the Communist Party of China" and other provisions, strengthen ideals and beliefs, establish a correct view of power, earnestly abide by the various provisions and requirements for clean governance, and ensure that power is used for the people, interests are sought for the people, and feelings are tied to the people. The president of each people's court should personally take charge, take the lead in giving integrity classes, and give at least one targeted integrity class to the whole court each year. Vice presidents and other members of the leadership should give at least one integrity class to the departments under their supervision each year. For newly appointed leading cadres, integrity talks should be conducted at the time of appointment, and integrity training should be provided in a timely manner.

3. Strengthen integrity education for judges in judicial work. People's courts at all levels should concentrate for a period of time each year to organize judges to seriously study the "Reader on Judicial Integrity", the "Basic Standards for Professional Ethics of Judges", the "Standards of Conduct for Judges (Trial)", and various integrity systems and disciplinary provisions of the court, so that judges continuously enhance their awareness of judicial integrity and consciously resist money worship, hedonism, and extreme individualism.

4. Strengthen the construction of a clean government culture in courts. Clean government culture is an important part of advanced socialist culture. People's courts at all levels should strengthen the construction of a clean government culture with the construction of a socialist core value system as the key point and the establishment of a socialist concept of honor and disgrace as the main content, formulate measures to strengthen the construction of a clean government culture, vigorously carry out the "Clean Government Culture Innovation Project" and the "Clean Government Culture Quality Project", and closely integrate ideological education, discipline education, social morality, professional ethics, family virtue, and integrity self-discipline education. Means such as literature and art, knowledge contests, publicity reports, picture exhibitions, special report meetings, literary performances, anti-corruption and integrity films and television programs, hanging aphorisms and calligraphy and painting works in office areas, opening special columns on local area networks, and organizing roving lecture groups should be used to extensively and deeply carry out anti-corruption and integrity education theme practice activities. Actively carry out activities to create "clean courts", "clean tribunals", "clean judges", "clean families", and various forms of family assistance activities for integrity, continuously promoting the construction of a clean government culture in courts.

5. Actively explore effective forms of anti-corruption and integrity education. In anti-corruption and integrity education, people's courts at all levels should link with the actual thoughts of judges and other staff, adhere to the combination of theory and practice, adhere to the combination of ideological education and professional ethics education, adhere to the combination of centralized education and regular education, and adhere to the combination of positive typical education and negative warning education. Incorporate anti-corruption and integrity education into the teaching plans of the National Judges College and its branches and local judges training colleges, implement the educational content, ensure class hours, and strengthen educational assessment. Make full use of negative typical cases of disciplinary and legal violations that have occurred in the local area or court, deeply analyze the causes, conscientiously sum up lessons, and ensure that the alarm bell rings constantly. Actively explore new ideas and new methods of anti-corruption and integrity education, and enhance the targeted and effective nature of anti-corruption and integrity education.

6. Establish and improve a long-term mechanism for anti-corruption and integrity education. People's courts at all levels should, in response to the ideological dynamics and work characteristics of various types of court personnel, establish and improve the study, teaching, discussion, and exchange systems for anti-corruption and integrity education, laying a good foundation for the assessment and inspection of anti-corruption and integrity education. Improve the assessment system for anti-corruption and integrity education, clarify assessment methods and standards, link assessment results with the evaluation of excellence and awards, and strive to promote continuous new achievements in anti-corruption and integrity education. Establish and improve the inspection system for anti-corruption and integrity education. Each year, people's courts at all levels should conduct a self-examination and summary of the anti-corruption and integrity education carried out in their own unit. Each year, higher courts should conduct random inspections of some lower courts. Courts with outstanding achievements in anti-corruption and integrity education should be commended, and courts where education is not implemented, perfunctory, or a mere formality should be criticized.

II. Strengthen Institutional Construction and Supervision, Strive to Establish a Preventive Mechanism for "Not Being Able to Do Wrong"

7. To do a good job in promoting integrity and combating corruption, it is necessary to strengthen institutional construction and the restriction and supervision of power, to move the threshold forward and prevent in advance. Effectively solve the problems of imperfect institutions and ineffective implementation of institutions. Institutional construction must be carried out through all aspects of anti-corruption and integrity work, further improve the anti-corruption and integrity institutional system of people's courts, and form a restrictive mechanism that uses institutions to regulate the professional behavior of judges and other staff, handle affairs according to institutions, and manage people by institutions. Focus on strengthening supervision over leading cadres at all levels in the court, especially the main leading cadres, the power of adjudication and execution, the management and use of personnel, finances, and materials, and other key positions, to prevent loss of control of power, wrong decision-making, and misconduct. Through strengthening institutional construction and the restriction and supervision of the operation of power, form a comprehensive shield against corruption in people's courts.

8. Fully implement the system of open trials. People's courts at all levels must strictly implement the system of open trials stipulated in the Constitution and laws, the Supreme People's Court's "Several Opinions on Strengthening the Work of Open Trials in People's Courts" and the "Several Provisions on Open Enforcement in People's Courts", effectively ensure openness in accordance with the law, conscientiously do a good job in announcing public trials, guarantee the right of citizens to attend trials, fully implement the system of open trials from all aspects such as case filing, trial, enforcement, and trial supervision, and consciously accept the supervision of parties and the masses.

9. Earnestly implement the system of single-judge trials. People's courts at all levels should strengthen the training of single judges, continuously improve their professional ethics and trial ability, and take corresponding measures to ensure and supervise the correct exercise of power by single judges.

10. Earnestly implement the collegial panel system. People's courts at all levels must strictly implement the collegial panel system stipulated by law and the Supreme People's Court's "Several Provisions on the Work of Collegial Panels in People's Courts" and the "Several Opinions on Improving the System for Presidents, Vice Presidents, Division Chiefs, and Deputy Division Chiefs to Participate in Collegial Panel Hearings". Members of the collegial panel should participate equally in the trial, evaluation, and adjudication of cases, and jointly bear responsibility for the determination of facts and application of law. When evaluating cases, members of the collegial panel should be conscientious and responsible, fully state their opinions, independently exercise their voting rights, give full play to the mutual checks and balances among members of the collegial panel, ensure the quality of cases, and prevent unjust adjudication.

11. Earnestly implement the system of the adjudication committee. People's courts at all levels must earnestly implement the system of the adjudication committee stipulated by law, and earnestly implement the various requirements of the Supreme People's Court regarding the reform of the adjudication committee. The adjudication committee should carefully try the cases submitted to it for discussion, members of the adjudication committee have the right to express their opinions equally, the adjudication committee implements democratic centralism, one vote per person, and decisions made must obtain the consent of more than half of the members to be passed, giving full play to the role of the highest adjudication organ within the court and ensuring the quality of adjudication.

12. Earnestly implement the system of people's assessors. People's courts at all levels must strictly implement the "Decision on Improving the System of People's Assessors" of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, the "Implementation Opinions on the Work of Selecting, Training, and Assessing People's Assessors" of the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice, and the "Measures for the Management of People's Assessors (Trial)" of the Supreme People's Court, to ensure that people's assessors participate in trial activities in accordance with the law. Further improve the management system for people's assessors, optimize the overall structure of people's assessors. Give full play to the role of people's assessors, listen to their opinions and suggestions on trial work at least once or twice a year, promote and promote judicial democracy, and accept the supervision of the masses.

13. Strictly implement the system of withdrawal. People's courts at all levels must strictly implement the provisions on withdrawal in the Judges Law and the Procedural Laws, as well as the Supreme People's Court's "Several Provisions on Strict Implementation of the Withdrawal System by Judicial Personnel". In accordance with the above laws and provisions, if a judicial personnel should withdraw, they should proactively raise it; if a party files an application, the president, adjudication committee, or presiding judge should promptly make a decision, to prevent the improper influence of personal relationships on judicial work, eliminate the reasonable suspicion of the parties, and ensure fair administration of justice.

14. Strictly abide by the system of time limits for case trials. People's courts at all levels must strictly implement the system of time limits for case trials stipulated by law and the Supreme People's Court's "Several Provisions on Strict Implementation of the System of Time Limits for Case Trials". When an extension of the time limit for case trial is needed, the approval procedures must be strictly followed, resolutely prevent delays in handling cases, improve the efficiency of trial and enforcement work, and protect the lawful rights and interests of parties.

15. Reform and improve the system of case jurisdiction. In accordance with the law and judicial interpretations, further establish and improve the system for cross-regional civil and administrative cases to be placed under the jurisdiction of a higher court, for a higher court to bring up cases for trial, or to designate another court for trial, so as to reduce and eliminate the improper influence and interference of local protectionism on the trial and enforcement of cases from an institutional perspective.

16. Reform and improve the enforcement system and working mechanism. Further improve the management system of enforcement work with unified management, unified coordination, and efficient operation, establish and improve the operational mechanism of separation of enforcement adjudication power and enforcement implementation power, with mutual checks and balances and mutual coordination, to ensure effective checks and balances in the exercise of enforcement power.

17. Improve the trial process management system. Establish a trial process management system with case trial as the core, gradually achieve full tracking and management of case trials, comprehensively monitor all stages such as case filing, trial, and enforcement, and avoid the occurrence of illegal handling of cases.

18. Implement and improve the system of case quality evaluation. Develop scientific standards and methods for case evaluation. People's courts at all levels should clarify the case quality evaluation body, focus on evaluating cases such as those remanded for retrial, reversed on second instance, reversed on retrial, and enforcement cases with strong complaints from parties involving illegal enforcement or delay in enforcement, and spot-check other cases. Through case quality evaluation, assess the professional level and case handling ability of judges, improve the quality of cases, and promptly discover problems in trial and enforcement work, as well as clues of illegal trial or illegal enforcement.

19. Improve the personnel management system. People's courts at all levels should establish a check system for the recruitment of judges and other staff to prevent unqualified persons from entering the court team. Establish a job rotation system for trial positions, implement and improve personnel management systems such as democratic recommendation, democratic assessment, differential investigation, pre-appointment publicity, and open selection. Earnestly implement the system of withdrawal, job rotation, and exchange for leading cadres, to prevent unhealthy tendencies and oversight in personnel selection.

20. Improve the system of cadre co-management by people's courts. Higher people's courts should give full play to their functional role in assisting the Party committee in managing cadres, strictly in accordance with the "Regulations on the Selection and Appointment of Party and Government Leading Cadres" and the Judges Law, strengthen communication and consultation with the Party committee, actively put forward opinions and suggestions on the allocation of leadership teams of lower people's courts, participate in the investigation, strictly control the qualification for appointment, and prevent problems such as "nomination with illness" or "promotion with illness". Higher people's courts may try out an inspection system to strengthen supervision and guidance over the leadership teams and members of lower people's courts.

21. Earnestly implement and improve the financial management system. People's courts at all levels must strictly implement the provisions on government procurement, construction project management, major project and large-sum fund use management. Strictly control official consumption, prohibit illegal construction of office buildings and halls, strictly investigate commercial bribery in material procurement and project bidding, etc. Strictly implement the "Measures for the Payment of Litigation Costs" and the relevant provisions on "separate revenue and expenditure" management, not to open accounts illegally, not to set up "small treasuries" or off-book accounts. Improve the management system of property involved in cases, strengthen financial audits, and prevent the occurrence of violations of financial discipline such as embezzling, misappropriating, or unlawfully taking property involved in cases.

22. Improve the supervision system of people's courts. Formulate the "Regulations on Supervision Work of People's Courts", strengthen supervisory functions, improve supervisory methods, increase supervisory efforts, so that the supervision work of people's courts is more suitable for the needs of anti-corruption and integrity work in people's courts, more suitable for the needs of the working rules of courts, ensure the correct implementation of national laws and regulations, and ensure judicial fairness and integrity.

23. Improve the disciplinary system of people's courts. Earnestly implement the disciplinary provisions of the "Civil Servant Law" and the "Judges Law", integrate existing disciplinary norms, formulate the "Regulations on Disciplinary Sanctions of People's Courts", and strictly enforce court discipline; formulate the "Procedural Rules for Disciplinary Sanctions against Judges", which not only strictly investigate and punish acts of judges violating discipline and law, but also fully protect the rights of the judge under investigation, and establish a disciplinary system for judges with Chinese characteristics. People's courts at all levels must earnestly implement the above normative documents.

24. Improve the system of accountability for illegal trials and illegal enforcement. Earnestly implement the "Measures for Accountability for Illegal Trial Conducts of Judicial Personnel of People's Courts (Trial)". If judicial personnel, during trial or enforcement work, intentionally violate laws and regulations related to trial work, or negligently violate laws and regulations related to trial work causing serious consequences, they shall bear liability for illegal trial. Research and explore new mechanisms and new measures for timely discovering clues of illegal trial and illegal enforcement within the court and actively investigating and punishing illegal trial and illegal enforcement conducts, to further promote the implementation of accountability for illegal trial and illegal enforcement.

25. Earnestly implement various integrity systems. People's courts at all levels must strictly implement the "Standards for Honest Conduct of Leading Cadres of the Communist Party of China (Trial)", the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection's "Several Provisions on Strictly Prohibiting the Use of Positional Convenience to Seek Improper Benefits", the Supreme People's Court and Ministry of Justice's "Several Provisions on Regulating the Relationship between Judges and Lawyers to Maintain Judicial Fairness", as well as integrity systems such as democratic life meetings, reporting work and integrity, admonishment talks and correspondence inquiries, reporting personal matters, employment of spouses and children, and employment after leaving office and retirement, to strengthen self-discipline and promote the honest self-discipline of leading cadres and judges in courts.

26. Strengthen supervision over leadership teams and leading cadres. Strengthen supervision over the implementation of the Scientific Outlook on Development by leadership teams and leading cadres at all levels in courts, to prevent and correct behaviors that violate the Scientific Outlook on Development. Supervise the implementation of democratic centralism, selection and appointment of cadres, implementation of the responsibility system for building a clean and honest Party style and the situation of clean governance and diligent work by court leadership teams and leading cadres. Supervise the implementation of systems such as reporting work and integrity, admonishment talks, correspondence inquiries, and reporting personal matters by court leadership teams and leading cadres. Comprehensively strengthen and improve the ideological style, study style, work style, leadership style, and lifestyle style of court leading cadres, focus on solving prominent problems in the style of court leading cadres, oppose and correct formalism, bureaucracy, hedonism, and deception.

27. Strengthen the supervision of higher people's courts over the trial work and enforcement work of lower people's courts. Higher people's courts must strengthen the supervision of trial levels in accordance with the law, and resolutely handle cases that should be remanded for retrial or reversed. Improve the retrial system, maintain judicial authority, correct erroneous judgments, and protect the lawful rights and interests of parties. Explore and improve new mechanisms for higher people's courts to effectively supervise the enforcement work of lower people's courts, to prevent the abuse of enforcement power.

28. Strengthen supervision by court presidents and division chiefs over judges and enforcement personnel. The supervisory duties commensurate with the positions of court presidents and division chiefs shall be scientifically defined to guide and supervise judges and enforcement personnel in handling cases impartially and lawfully. The supervision of integrity in adjudication and enforcement work shall be regarded as an important responsibility of leading cadres of people's courts at all levels and their adjudication business departments, and shall be incorporated into the responsibility system for the construction of the Party's conduct and integrity of leading cadres in courts, forming a work pattern where supervision is promoted at each level. Court presidents and division chiefs shall implement dynamic supervision through receiving visits, handling letters, observing trials, and guiding case handling.

29. Strengthen supervision over personnel and financial management. Supervise the exercise of personnel authority. Conscientiously implement supervisory provisions such as the "Measures for Supervision and Inspection of the Selection and Appointment of Leading Cadres of the Party and Government (Trial)" and the "Opinions on Strengthening the Supervision Work of Organization Department Cadres," strengthen supervision over the entire process of cadre selection and appointment, and strictly investigate and punish disciplinary and illegal acts such as seeking or purchasing official positions and selling official positions. Strengthen supervision over financial management, earnestly implement various rules and regulations on financial management, and intensify supervision and inspection of departmental budgets, government procurement, "separate revenue and expenditure management," and the management of state-owned assets.

30. Consciously accept supervision by the People's Congress, legal supervision, and social supervision. People's courts at all levels shall, in accordance with the requirements of the Supervision Law, consciously accept supervision by the People's Congress, earnestly implement the "Several Opinions on the People's Courts Accepting Supervision by the People's Congress and Its Standing Committee," report work to the People's Congress and its Standing Committee at the same level with a sense of responsibility, carefully listen to and promptly respond to criticisms and suggestions from People's Congress deputies regarding court work. Cases protested by the procuratorial authority shall be tried seriously, and written opinions from the procuratorial authority shall be treated with due attention. Consciously accept social supervision, carefully listen to criticisms and opinions, and continuously improve work; for reports of disciplinary, illegal, or corrupt conduct by court staff, efforts shall be promptly organized to verify the facts; if confirmed upon investigation, the matter shall be dealt with severely.

III. Intensity Efforts to Punish Corruption, Further Strengthen the Punishment Mechanism of "Dare Not Act"

31. Resolutely investigate and handle disciplinary and illegal cases. Currently, disciplinary and illegal cases remain prone to occurring and recurring in some courts and some departments, and the serious disciplinary and illegal conduct of a very small number of leading cadres in courts has a detrimental impact. The situation for anti-corruption and integrity remains severe, and the punitive measure must never be relaxed at any time. Effective punishment can enhance the persuasive power of education, the binding force of institutions, and the deterrent effect of supervision. We must adhere to the principle that everyone is equal before the law and discipline, and any corrupt element must be severely punished according to law without leniency.

32. Focus on investigating cases of leading cadres of courts abusing their power, engaging in bribery and corruption, dereliction of duty, malfeasance, and new forms of power-for-money exchanges that seek improper benefits through the use of their positions. People's courts at all levels shall consistently regard disciplinary and illegal cases involving leading cadres as the focus of investigation. Where any of the above-mentioned disciplinary or illegal acts occur, Party discipline and administrative sanctions shall be firmly imposed according to discipline and law; if the Criminal Law is violated, criminal liability shall be pursued according to law.

33. Seriously investigate cases of engaging in favoritism and malpractice, rendering judgments perverted by law, and delaying case handling. People's courts at all levels shall strengthen supervision and inspection of judges and enforcement personnel in the exercise of judicial and enforcement powers to ensure impartial justice. Where any of the above-mentioned disciplinary or illegal acts occur, they shall be seriously investigated; if a disciplinary violation is constituted, it shall be dealt with resolutely; if the person is unsuitable to serve as a judge, the position shall be removed according to law.

34. Seriously investigate cases of moral degradation and depravity. People's courts at all levels shall strengthen moral education for judges and other staff, cultivate noble and healthy life interests, and establish a good image of judges. Where any of the above-mentioned disciplinary acts occur, they shall be dealt with severely; those causing adverse effects shall be expelled from the court team.

35. Conduct special rectification campaigns targeting prominent issues. People's courts at all levels may, in light of prominent issues in their respective regions or courts and issues strongly reflected by the masses, plan special rectification, special governance, or special inspections, and handle disciplinary or illegal acts found in accordance with relevant regulations.

36. Strengthen work on petitions and reports via letters and visits. People's courts at all levels shall diligently handle petitions and reports, striving to discover clues of disciplinary or illegal acts. Channels for petitions and reports shall be expanded, hotline numbers set up, and made public. Mechanisms for feedback and responses to real-name reports shall be improved. Attention shall be paid to discovering clues of disciplinary or illegal acts from law enforcement inspections, special inspections, and case evaluations.

37. Strictly handle cases in accordance with discipline and law. People's courts at all levels shall ensure that handling cases in accordance with discipline and law runs through all stages, including case filing, investigation, adjudication, sanction, and execution. A balance of leniency and severity shall be applied based on specific circumstances. Both disciplinary sanctions and organizational measures shall be comprehensively utilized. Judges and other staff who are the subject of false accusations, mistaken reports, or retaliation shall be promptly exonerated and effectively protected.

38. Continuously increase efforts in handling cases on their own initiative. People's courts at all levels shall further adopt effective measures to proactively discover clues of disciplinary or illegal acts, actively organize forces to handle cases on their own initiative. The system of leading cadres assuming responsibility for specific cases shall be strengthened. Through investigating cases, problems shall be identified and loopholes plugged, thereby exerting the fundamental function of case investigation.

39. Strive to enhance the ability to investigate, verify, and break cases. People's courts at all levels shall continuously strengthen their ability to investigate, verify, and break cases, attach importance to the selection and use of case-handling personnel, strengthen the study and training of such personnel, and ensure their relative stability. Regular exchanges of case-handling work experience shall be conducted to continuously improve the capability and level of investigating cases.

40. Strengthen guidance on the case investigation work of lower-level people's courts. Higher-level people's courts shall promptly guide and support lower-level people's courts in investigating disciplinary and illegal cases; where coordination by the higher-level court is needed, it shall be handled conscientiously and responsibly; requests from lower-level courts on the application of discipline shall be responded to promptly.

41. Leading cadres shall strongly support the investigation of disciplinary, illegal, and corruption cases. Leading cadres, especially principal leading cadres, of people's courts at all levels shall vigorously support the discipline inspection and supervision departments in investigating cases; if cases are not investigated when they exist, or are suppressed and not investigated, or even interference in case investigation occurs, the responsibility of the relevant leading cadres shall be pursued.

42. Explore the mechanism for cooperation between the supervision departments of people's courts and discipline inspection authorities in handling cases. The supervision departments of people's courts at all levels shall earnestly perform their supervisory functions, take the initiative to play their role, strengthen contact and cooperation with discipline inspection authorities, actively participate in the preliminary examination and investigation of court staff by discipline inspection authorities, and continuously improve their case-handling standards.

43. Explore the working mechanism for communication between the supervision departments of people's courts and the procuratorial authorities. The supervision departments of people's courts at all levels shall proactively communicate with the procuratorial authorities, promptly exchange information, and take the initiative to investigate disciplinary and illegal cases.

IV. Combine Strict Court Governance with Favorable Treatment of Judges, Actively Explore the "Need Not Act" Guarantee Mechanism

44. Combining strict court governance with favorable treatment of judges plays an important role in preventing and punishing corruption, enhancing the honor of judges, and motivating judges. Through efforts, continuously improving the treatment of judges is conducive to reducing the occurrence of disciplinary and illegal problems. Policies providing favorable treatment to judges shall be earnestly implemented, mechanisms for protecting judges' rights and interests shall be actively explored, the protection of judges' rights and interests shall be effectively strengthened, and the material living conditions of judges shall be continuously improved.

45. Earnestly safeguard the various lawful rights and interests of judges and other staff. People's courts at all levels shall conscientiously implement the Civil Servant Law, the Judges Law, the CPC Central Committee's "Decision on Further Strengthening the Work of People's Courts and People's Procuratorates," and the Supreme People's Court's "Several Provisions on Safeguarding Judges' Rights According to Law," to ensure that judges adjudicate cases independently according to law, free from interference by administrative organs, social organizations, and individuals; ensure that judges are not removed from office, demoted, dismissed, or sanctioned except on statutory grounds and through statutory procedures; and safeguard the personal, property, and residential safety of judges and other staff, as well as all their other lawful rights and interests.

46. Reform and improve the court funding guarantee system. Earnestly implement the new mechanism for court funding guarantees, strictly enforce the "Administrative Measures for the Special Case-Handling Funds Subsidized by the Central Government to People's Courts," and ensure that central financial special funds are used for case-handling expenses.

47. Strengthen material and equipment construction. People's courts at all levels shall pay close attention to material and equipment construction, especially the construction of "two courtrooms" (court premises and judgment venues). Scientific and technological investment shall be increased, office automation and information technology construction shall be continuously strengthened, and the networking of trial management, intellectualization of administrative management, and informatization of personnel management shall be gradually achieved, striving to create a comfortable, convenient, and good working environment for judges and other staff.

48. Strengthen and standardize reward work. People's courts at all levels shall establish and improve the assessment and reward mechanisms for judges and other staff, providing necessary rewards to those who perform well and make significant contributions, encouraging the majority of judges and other staff to love their jobs and work diligently.

49. Earnestly implement the judicial allowance for judges. People's courts at all levels shall promptly carry out the evaluation and promotion of judge ranks in accordance with the "Provisional Regulations on the Ranks of Judges of the People's Republic of China." In accordance with the "Notice on Implementing the Judicial Allowance for Judges" jointly issued by the Ministry of Personnel and the Ministry of Finance of the state, communication with local government financial departments shall be strengthened to ensure the monthly full disbursement of the judicial allowance.

50. Gradually improve the welfare benefits of judges and other staff. People's courts at all levels shall pay attention to issues such as the housing, medical care, spousal separation, and children's schooling and employment of judges and other staff. Where assistance can be provided, every effort shall be made to create conditions to solve these problems, continuously improving the welfare benefits of judges and other staff.

51. Pay attention to and care for the family life of judges and other staff with special difficulties. People's courts at all levels shall treat the solution to the family life of judges and other staff with special difficulties as a major matter. The principal leaders of the court shall personally oversee the matter, the leaders in charge shall personally take the lead, and the functional departments shall be responsible for coordinating and implementing measures, making every effort to solve their practical difficulties.

52. Continue to pilot the integrity bond system. The practice of some courts piloting the integrity bond system has proven that this system plays a positive role in strengthening the integrity awareness of judges and other staff and preventing the occurrence of disciplinary and illegal problems. Courts with the necessary conditions, after obtaining the consent of the Party Committee and the government, shall continue to pilot the system and continuously improve it in practice.
